Add Passive Card

A passive card is email-linked. OTP from the card provider goes to the linked email. Users don't see the email — it's backend only.

⚠️ Each passive card must use a unique email to avoid OTP mix-ups.

⚠️ Warning: Using the same email for multiple cards will cause OTPs to go to the wrong card. Always use unique emails.
